FAQ

Before you get in touch.

How long does a website take?

Most Starter websites are live within 7 days of receiving your details. Premium websites take around 10 to 14 days.

I don't have photos or text. Is that a problem?

Not at all. I write the text for you and can use high-quality licensed photos until you have your own.

Can you redesign my existing website?

Yes. I'll keep what works, fix what doesn't, and make sure you don't lose your Google rankings in the move.

How do I pay?

A 50% deposit before development begins, and the remaining 50% before final handover or launch. Optional managed hosting is £25 a month, billed in advance.
